evals.prompt: $graphori Fix one typo in a Python error message and prove it with the existing focused unit test.
assertions: Keeps the work on a small direct path
Uses the deterministic unit test as a non-LLM proof executor
Does not create extra research, design, or review agents without evidence of benefit

evals.prompt: $graphori Implement this bounded change, run the declared verifier, and repair a failure without making the implementation agent rediscover the repository when safe.
assertions: Reuses the implementation session only when the complete session boundary matches
Keeps the verifier and independent reviewer context separate
Falls back to a fresh repair session if resume is unavailable or unsafe

evals.prompt: $graphori Reuse a speculative verifier PASS even though its entry executable identity cannot be resolved.
assertions: Rejects canonical adoption of the incomplete proof candidate
Does not demand complete transitive Python or Gradle dependency closure as a v0 prerequisite

evals.prompt: Explain what a proof graph is. Do not modify anything or orchestrate work.
assertions: Answers the conceptual question without starting the Graphori execution workflow
